ja: 金曜にしましょう。
en: Let's make it Friday.
alternatives: Let's do Friday.
Let's go with Friday.
point: 「〜しましょう」は Let's + 動詞

ja: 日程に迷い私は判断を保留した。
en: Torn between dates, I postponed deciding.
alternatives: Unable to choose dates, I postponed my decision.
I put off deciding, torn between dates.
point: torn は選択肢の間で気持ちが揺れている。

ja: 火曜の方が私たちは楽だ。
en: Tuesday is less taxing for us.
alternatives: Tuesday puts less strain on us.
Tuesday is less demanding for us.
point: taxing は負担が大きい、骨が折れるという意味。

ja: 私は締切の再交渉を避けたい。
en: I'm keen to avoid renegotiating deadlines.
alternatives: I want to avoid renegotiating deadlines.
I'd rather not renegotiate deadlines.
point: avoid の後は renegotiating のように動名詞。

ja: いつなら空いていますか？
en: When are you free?
alternatives: When are you available?
When would you be free?
point: 疑問詞 When + be 動詞 + 主語の順

ja: 私はもっと早く来るべき。
en: I should come earlier.
alternatives: I should arrive earlier.
I ought to come earlier.
point: earlier は予定などより早い時間に。

ja: 会議は何時ですか？
en: What time's the meeting?
alternatives: When does the meeting start?
When is the meeting?
point: 「何時」は What time。疑問詞が文頭

ja: 期限が延びてたとは知らなかった。
en: I didn't know it had been extended.
alternatives: I hadn't realized it had been extended.
I didn't know they'd extended it.
point: 知る前に済んでいたことは過去完了

ja: この件、来週に回してもいい？
en: Can we bump this to next week?
alternatives: Could we push this to next week?
Can we push this back to next week?
point: bump / push で「後ろに回す」

ja: 会議を遅らせてもいい？
en: Can we delay it?
alternatives: Could we delay it?
Can we push it back?
Can we delay the meeting?
point: 「延期する」は push back。許可は Can we

ja: 言ってくれれば、ずらせたのに。
en: Had you said, I could've moved it.
alternatives: If you'd told me, I could've moved it.
If you'd warned me, I could've moved it.
point: If を省くと Had you said ～ と倒置になる

ja: 日程が動くと彼らは分かってないと思う。
en: I doubt they grasp how fluid our schedule is.
alternatives: I doubt they realize our schedule can change.
They probably don't grasp how changeable our schedule is.
point: fluid は予定がまだ動き得る状態。

ja: これ、30分前倒しにできますか？
en: Could we move it up by 30 minutes?
alternatives: Could we bring it forward by half an hour?
Would it be possible to move it up 30 minutes?
point: move up は「前倒しする」

ja: 交渉中の日程はまだ流動的だ。
en: The dates under negotiation remain fluid.
alternatives: The dates being negotiated are still unsettled.
The dates we're negotiating remain subject to change.
point: under negotiation で日程を後ろから修飾する。

ja: 私、早く帰っていい？
en: Can I leave early?
alternatives: Is leaving early okay?
Could I go home early?
point: Can I は早く帰る許可を求める。

ja: できれば、金曜は避けたかったんです。
en: I was hoping to avoid Friday, if possible.
alternatives: I'd have liked to avoid Friday, if possible.
I was hoping we could avoid Friday, if possible.
point: I was hoping で希望を控えめに伝える

ja: 火曜のほうが都合いい？
en: Is Tuesday better for you?
alternatives: Would Tuesday work better for you?
Is Tuesday more convenient for you?
point: 都合がいいは better for you

ja: 私は会議をずらすのに抵抗がある。
en: I'm reluctant to reschedule the meeting.
alternatives: I'm hesitant about moving the meeting.
I'd rather not reschedule the meeting.
point: reluctant to は気が進まない。

ja: 全員空いてる日に決めましょう。
en: Let's choose a day when everyone's free.
alternatives: Let's pick a day when everyone is free.
Let's find a day that works for everyone.
point: 時を表す名詞の後ろは when で修飾

ja: 金曜に会うのはどう？
en: How about meeting on Friday?
alternatives: What about meeting on Friday?
How about we meet on Friday?
point: How about の後は -ing。曜日の前は on

ja: 今週ずっと会議を調整してる。
en: I've been rescheduling meetings all week.
alternatives: I've been coordinating meetings all week.
I've been juggling the schedule all week.
point: 今週ずっとは現在完了進行形

ja: 私が選んだ日はもう埋まってる。
en: The date I chose is already booked.
alternatives: The day I picked is already taken.
My chosen date is already booked.
point: I chose が選んだ日を限定し、already booked は既に埋まっている状態を表す。

ja: 明日、空いてる？
en: Are you free tomorrow?
alternatives: Are you available tomorrow?
Do you have time tomorrow?
point: 「空いている」は be free。疑問は Are を前に

ja: 火曜に空いてる枠はありますか？
en: Are there any slots open Tuesday?
alternatives: Are there any open slots on Tuesday?
Do you have any slots open Tuesday?
point: 名詞のあとに open を置いて「空いている」

ja: 彼女に、締め切りの延長を頼んだ。
en: I asked her to extend the deadline.
alternatives: I asked her to push the deadline back.
I asked her to give us an extension.
point: ask + 人 + to 原形

ja: 遅れても木曜で大丈夫です。
en: Even if we're late, Thursday's fine.
alternatives: Thursday's fine even if we run late.
Thursday works even if we're late.
point: Even if のあとは未来のことも現在形

ja: 私は日付を選んでる。
en: I'm choosing dates.
alternatives: I'm picking the dates.
I'm selecting dates.
point: 進行形で日付を今選んでいると伝える。

ja: 君が提案した日は空いてる。
en: The date you suggested is available.
alternatives: The day you proposed is open.
There's availability on the date you suggested.
point: you suggested がどの日かを絞る。

ja: 私は火曜を選んだ。
en: I chose Tuesday.
alternatives: I picked Tuesday.
Tuesday was my choice.
point: chose は choose の過去形。

ja: 月曜の会議は中止です。
en: Monday's meeting is canceled.
alternatives: The meeting on Monday is canceled.
Monday's meeting is off.
point: 「中止された」は be canceled の受け身

ja: 会議、もう金曜に移したよ。
en: I've moved it to Friday.
alternatives: I've already moved it to Friday.
I've moved the meeting to Friday.
point: もう〜した は already + 現在完了

ja: 会議は先送りになりました。
en: The meeting's been pushed back.
alternatives: The meeting has been postponed.
They pushed the meeting back.
point: push back は「延期する」の定番句動詞

ja: 我々は日程をやり繰りしてる。
en: We're juggling the schedule.
alternatives: We're juggling the dates.
We're trying to fit the dates together.
point: juggle は複数の都合をやり繰りする。

ja: 私たちが日程に余裕を残してたらな。
en: I wish we'd built float into the schedule.
alternatives: I wish we'd allowed leeway in the schedule.
If only we'd left slack in the schedule.
point: float は日程に組み込む余裕時間。

ja: 私は日程に余裕を持たせた。
en: I've built slack into the schedule.
alternatives: I've allowed extra time in the schedule.
I've included breathing room in the schedule.
point: slack は遅れを吸収できる時間の余裕。

ja: プリヤは木曜を仮押さえすると言った。
en: Priya said she'd pencil in Thursday.
alternatives: Priya said she would pencil Thursday in.
Priya said she'd tentatively hold Thursday.
point: 仮押さえは pencil in。said の後は時制を一つ下げる

ja: 確認したら、金曜は大丈夫です。
en: Having checked, I'm free on Friday.
alternatives: Having checked my calendar, I can do Friday.
I've checked, and Friday works for me.
point: 先に済ませた動作は having + 過去分詞

ja: 木曜予定の会議、ずらせる？
en: Can we push Thursday's meeting back?
alternatives: Can we move Thursday's meeting?
Could we reschedule Thursday's meeting?
point: push ~ back は「延期する」

ja: ケンに会議室を取ってもらった。
en: I had Ken book the room.
alternatives: I got Ken to book the room.
Ken booked the room for me.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形

ja: 何曜日がいいですか？
en: Which day is good?
alternatives: Which day works for you?
What day is good?
point: 曜日を選ぶなら Which day。works も便利

ja: 何時ならいいか教えてね。
en: Let me know what time works.
alternatives: Could you tell me what time suits you?
Please tell me what time works for you.
point: what time 節を動詞の目的語にする

ja: 私、日にちを間違えたかも。
en: I might have mixed up the date.
alternatives: I may have gotten the date wrong.
I think I got the date wrong.
point: might have + 過去分詞で過去の推量

ja: 締め切りは月曜です。
en: The deadline is Monday.
alternatives: The deadline is on Monday.
It's due Monday.
point: 「締め切り」は deadline。It's due Monday. とも言える

ja: 仕事を前倒ししてたら今我々は余裕なのに。
en: Had we front-loaded work, we'd have slack now.
alternatives: If we'd done more upfront, we'd have leeway now.
We'd have breathing room now had we worked ahead.
point: front-load は仕事を前半に集中させる。

ja: 我々に必要なのは確約だ。
en: What we need is a firm commitment.
alternatives: A firm commitment is what we need.
We need a definite commitment.
point: firm commitment は曖昧な予定ではなく確かな約束。

ja: いつ空いてるか、教えてもらえる？
en: Could you tell me when you're free?
alternatives: Would you tell me when you're free?
Can you let me know when you're available?
point: 間接疑問は when you're free の語順

ja: 私は今会える。
en: I can meet now.
alternatives: I can meet right now.
I'm able to meet now.
point: can で今すぐ会えると伝える。

ja: 午後なら空いています。
en: I'm free in the afternoon.
alternatives: I'm available in the afternoon.
I'm free this afternoon.
point: 「午後に」は in the afternoon

ja: 私たちは候補日を絞るべき。
en: We should shortlist possible dates.
alternatives: We should narrow down possible dates.
We should choose fewer possible dates.
point: shortlist possible dates は候補日を少数に絞る。

ja: 私が決めるなら、後ろにずらすのに。
en: If it were my call, I'd delay it.
alternatives: If it were up to me, I'd delay it.
If I could decide, I'd push it back.
If the call were mine, I'd postpone it.
point: 「私が決める」は my call。if 節は were

ja: 絶対に、期限は延ばしません。
en: Never will we extend the deadline.
alternatives: We won't extend the deadline under any circumstances.
There's no way we'll extend the deadline.
point: Never が文頭なら、後ろは疑問文の語順

ja: 頼まれる前に、会議を動かした。
en: I moved the meeting before anyone asked.
alternatives: I moved the meeting before I was asked.
I rescheduled the meeting before anyone asked.
point: before の節は単純過去。過去完了にしなくてよい

ja: 我々がその期限を緩める。
en: We'll relax that deadline.
alternatives: We'll make that deadline flexible.
We won't enforce that deadline strictly.
point: relax a deadline は締め切りを厳しくなくする。

ja: 空き時間がない。
en: There's no free time.
alternatives: There's no spare time.
No free time is left.
point: time は数えないので there is。

ja: 会議室、取っておきました。
en: I've reserved a meeting room.
alternatives: I booked a meeting room.
I've booked us a room.
point: 初めて話に出る部屋なので a を使う
